inputs.style: Acoustic instrumental planetary exploration music, 84 BPM, G lydian. Only three dry acoustic instruments: a nylon-string classical guitar playing clearly plucked individual notes, a grand piano playing short detached notes, and sparse woodblock percussion. A gentle curious wandering melody, open space, friendly fantasy discovery. No bowed instruments, no pads, no synthesizer, no human sounds. Clean close-miked acoustic production. Original video game instrumental score. Only musical instruments. No vocals, no singing, no speech, no choir, no humming, no vocal samples. Clear melodic phrases, restrained dynamics, spacious clean production, gentle high frequencies, controlled bass, seamless flowing arrangement.
inputs.lyrics:
[Instrumental guitar introduction: detached plucked notes in G lydian]
[Instrumental guitar melody with short answering piano notes]
[Instrumental piano melody with gentle guitar arpeggios and sparse woodblock]
[Instrumental guitar reprise and a resolving piano chord]
